other_failure_modes.description: Casting string columns to pandas 'category' dtype independently on train, validation, and test splits assigns different integer codes to the same categories across splits if unique values differ. summary: The agent builds a solid cross-validation and ensembling pipeline but introduces critical bugs in categorical data handling and target encoding. Independent categorical casting causes feature misalignment across splits, and in-fold target encoding introduces severe target leakage.
